description: 高精度确定性单位换算（11 类 64 单位，50 位精度）/ Deterministic unit converter across 11 physical dimensions (length/area/volume/mass/temperature/speed/data/pressure/energy/power/angle, incl. CN mu/jin/chi, KB/KiB, kcal/kWh, PS/hp). Category is auto-inferred from from/to when omitted. Example: {"value": 100, "from": "km", "to": "mile"}.

category.description: 可选物理量类别（省略时自动按 from/to 推断）/ Optional category: length|area|volume|mass|temperature|speed|data|pressure|energy|power|angle

from.description: 源单位 ID（不区分大小写，支持常见别名如 lb/ft/in/km/h/celsius）/ Source unit ID, e.g. km, m, kg, jin, c, f, mb, mib, kpa, kcal, kw, deg

to.description: 目标单位 ID（须与 from 属于同一物理量纲）/ Target unit ID in the same category, e.g. mile, foot, pound, f, gib, psi, kwh, hp, rad

value.description: 待换算数值 / Numeric value (number or string, |v| in 1e-30..1e30), e.g. 100

name: convert_units
title: 单位换算（妙用盒）
